canonical_drive.title: RAFAELIA — Implementação Latentes e Papers — Drive GitHub V1
canonical_drive.method: source -> index -> semantic_token -> claim -> evidence -> falsifier -> decision -> artifact

uncertainties.next_action: Continue read-only monitoring and fail closed on any chain discontinuity.
uncertainties.exit_criterion: Four current main-branch receipts form an unbroken previous_entry_sha256 chain with latest_four_count=4 and claim_allowed=false.
uncertainties.falsifier: Any missing run, non-READ_ONLY decision, latest_four_count != 4, claim_allowed=true, or broken previous-entry chain.

uncertainties.next_action: Execute normalized joint multi-probe nested sampling under a frozen data/prior/likelihood contract and emit evidence plus uncertainty receipts.
uncertainties.exit_criterion: Receipt identifies frozen inputs, priors, likelihoods, sampler/version, seeds, convergence diagnostics, logZ with uncertainty, hashes and claim_allowed=false.
uncertainties.falsifier: A BIC proxy, SN-only evidence or undocumented sampler output is presented as joint multi-probe Bayes.

uncertainties.next_action: Reproduce the frozen scientific contract in a genuinely independent environment or implementation and compare declared tolerances.
uncertainties.exit_criterion: Independent receipt proves same inputs and model contract, different environment or implementation, numerical tolerance pass, environment identity and hashes.
uncertainties.falsifier: Second execution uses the same controlled runner/implementation without independent custody.

uncertainties.next_action: Run the hardened replay contract on a physical Android/Termux device and return the signed/hash-bound capsule.
uncertainties.exit_criterion: Physical receipt contains Android/device identity, environment, exact commit, command/log, two byte-identical replays and checksums validated by the repository gate.
uncertainties.falsifier: Linux CI, emulator-only output or synthetic fixture is presented as physical Termux execution.

uncertainties.next_action: Reproduce the official DESI DR2 joint/cross-block likelihood with pinning and custody rather than a local block-only substitute.
uncertainties.exit_criterion: Official joint/cross-block inputs, covariance and likelihood path are hash-bound and reproduced with an auditable receipt.
uncertainties.falsifier: Local 13-observable or block-diagonal control is relabeled as official joint/cross-block reproduction.

uncertainties.next_action: Extend read-only semantic dependency mapping beyond B0/B1 without bulk forward-porting.
uncertainties.exit_criterion: All candidate dependency edges outside B0/B1 are evidence-backed or explicitly TOKEN_VAZIO; no invented edge remains.
uncertainties.falsifier: Zero textual overlap is used as proof of zero semantic dependency.

uncertainties.next_action: Materialize executable consumer evidence for the five remaining artifacts or preserve each as TOKEN_VAZIO_EXECUTABLE_CONSUMER.
uncertainties.exit_criterion: Each of the five artifact consumers has a demonstrated executable read edge or an explicit unresolved token with falsifier.
uncertainties.falsifier: Upload/custody or documentary references are relabeled as executable consumption.

uncertainties.next_action: Preserve as historical evidence only; do not use it to close the joint multi-probe token.
uncertainties.exit_criterion: Historical receipt remains immutable and scope-labeled.
uncertainties.falsifier: Historical FASE20 nested sampling is silently promoted to current joint multi-probe evidence.

uncertainties.next_action: Preserve the SN-only result and require a separate joint multi-probe execution for broader claims.
uncertainties.exit_criterion: SN-only evidence remains scope-labeled with priors and uncertainties.
uncertainties.falsifier: SN-only Bayes is transplanted into a multi-probe claim.
